system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a Helm chart (Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/) deploying a generic web application: Deployment, Service, Ingress, and ConfigMap. The chart should be parameterizable via values for image, replicas, and host.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Create a Helm chart (Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/) deploying a generic web application: Deployment, Service, Ingress, and ConfigMap. The chart should be parameterizable via values for image, replicas, and host.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: webapp
description: Production-grade Helm chart for a generic web application
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 3
image:
  repository: nginx
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  tag: "1.25-alpine"
config:
  env: production
  logLevel: info
ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: nginx
  host: example.com
  tls: false
resources:
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "webapp.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- define "webapp.labels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}-config
  labels:
    {{- include "webapp.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
data:
  APP_ENV: {{ .Values.config.env | quote }}
  LOG_LEVEL: {{ .Values.config.logLevel | quote }}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "webapp.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "webapp.labels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}-config
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "webapp.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
---
# FILE: templates/ingress.yaml
{{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "webapp.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
spec:
  ingressClassName: {{ .Values.ingress.className }}
  rules:
    - host: {{ .Values.ingress.host }}
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}
                port:
                  number: 80
  {{- if .Values.ingress.tls }}
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - {{ .Values.ingress.host }}
      secretName: {{ include "webapp.name" . }}-tls
  {{- end }}
{{- end }}
